record.reason: The study evaluates pruning and quantization on conventional ANN classifiers for COMPAS, trauma and employment datasets, proposing agreement and subgroup-bias/chi-squared metrics. It finds high aggregate accuracy can hide behavior/fairness shifts after compression. It is useful as general compression evaluation context, but contains no language model or LLM inference/serving method, making the connection weak.
record.title: Downsized and Compromised?: Assessing the Faithfulness of Model Compression
